prompt:
Hand-drawn 2D game art for a side-on underground survival game. Clean, confident dark-brown ink linework of even weight, thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with slightly hand-made wobble. Flat colour fills with one crisp-edged shadow tone and one small highlight, lit evenly from the upper left. A faint paper-grain texture inside the fills only. Big simple shapes and generous plain areas; detail only where the eye should go. Muted, cold palette; warm colours only for fire, scarves and skin. In the spirit of Klei's Don't Starve and Oxygen Not Included and the flat graphic look of the Hilda animated series. Not photoreal, not 3D-rendered, no airbrushed gradients, no glow, no bloom, no rim light, no lens effects, no cast shadow on the ground, no background, no text.
Reference: Mara turnaround. The same character as the reference, same proportions, same colours. Make SIDE VIEW separated puppet parts, 4 columns by 2 rows equal square cells, no labels/grid lines, generous transparent space. Facing RIGHT. Row 1 cells: complete head with ochre striped beanie earflaps bobble, auburn braid, face and neck stub; complete moss-green coat torso ONLY with teal scarf wrapped collar, brown leather apron with tongs pocket, cream fur hem, no head/arms/legs; teal trailing scarf tail ONLY; near straight rigid arm with green sleeve cream fur cuff brown mitten. Row 2: far straight arm one darker tone; near straight grey trouser leg and brown boot toe pointing RIGHT; far straight grey trouser leg with boot one darker tone; empty cell. Complete rounded upper caps for arms and legs to extend under torso, arms perfectly straight no bent elbows. Flat fills, no gradients.
